home.title: Knowledge is everywhere. <mark>Find your next step.</mark>
home.description: Learning gets easier when useful resources connect. Explore courses and academic references with context, at your own pace.
home.open: Open resources · No paywall · Context-led curation
home.question: What do you want to understand next?
home.connect: A question. A resource. A connection that makes sense.
home.startDescription: Published routes that turn curiosity into learning.
home.thread: Follow the thread. Find a new connection.
home.threadDescription: A course provides structure. A curricular unit offers context. A resource opens a possibility. FACODI brings these pieces together without imposing a single path.

courses.title: Courses
courses.text: Complete paths with a study plan, credits and units organised by year and semester.

units.title: Curricular units
units.text: Pieces of a course you can explore on their own: goals, credits and the context they fit into.

resources.title: Resources
resources.text: Open educational objects — texts, videos and references — with topics and a link to the original source.

videos.title: Videos
videos.text: Open lessons and explanations, organised into trails by curricular unit.

ask.title: Ask
ask.text: Start from what you want to understand, not from an index.

explore.title: Explore
explore.text: Search published courses, units and resources at your own pace.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Every resource points to the course and unit where it makes sense.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.text: Suggest improvements and new resources. The editorial team reviews before publishing.

home.topicsDescription: The most frequent topics across published resources.

about.title: An open campus to follow the thread of knowledge.
about.lead: FACODI brings courses, curricular units and educational resources together in one place, with the context that makes them useful.
about.seaeuTitle: SEA-EU and the University of the Algarve
about.seaeuText: FACODI is part of the SEA-EU Student-Led Projects 2026 and was born at the University of the Algarve (UAlg).
about.seaeuScope: The goal is simple: make quality academic material easier to find, and make it clear where each piece fits in a learning path.

open.title: Open
open.text: The published catalogue can be browsed without an account and without a paywall.

context.title: In context
context.text: A resource is worth more when you know which course and unit it belongs to.

curated.title: Curated
curated.text: Only what the editorial team has reviewed is published. Access rules are enforced by the database.

about.contributeText: Contributions go through the editorial team: nothing is published automatically.

flow.account: Create a FACODI account with your email.
flow.review: Share your proposal with the editorial team, who prepare the content as a draft.
flow.publish: Once reviewed, the content is published in the open catalogue.
